newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK SAX INDEX FALLS IN DULL TRADING.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK SAX INDEX FALLS IN DULL TRADING.

text.p: Slovak shares opened the week in lacklustre mood with blue chips mostly untraded.
The 16-share SAX index eased 0.24 points on Monday to 169.07, pulled down by a 100-crown decline from drug producer Slovakofarma . Slovakofarma closed at 3,800 crowns, but traded only two shares.
Steel maker VSZ dominated trading on the bourse floor, with 896 shares traded and a closing price of 645, up five crowns from Friday.
Other top shares were quiet, or traded only insignificant volumes, such as textiles producer Ozeta, which decreased by 14 crowns to 245, on eight shares.
Overall, volume fell to 293,821 shares, from 559,215 shares traded on Friday, while turnover decreased to 278.87 million crowns, from 471.5 million.
Both volume and turnover were boosted by direct trades. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402
